disk_contract.notes: Physical reserve file is separate from bounded8GiB payload budget. Entry requires10GiB reserve+8GiB payload+1GiB freefloor. No claim that this is a filesystem quota or that unrelated writers cannot exhaust the unreserved freefloor.

commit_protocol: Keep existing append order, raw byte SHA, row framing, compression preset1 and no decimation. Each complete part receives exact index/first_row/row_count/raw+compressed size/hash.
Write compressed data and immutable per-part record into a unique staging directory on SSD; fsync both regular files and staging directory.
Rename complete staging directory into fresh committed part namespace under exclusive producer lock; fsync parent directory. Never replace an existing committed part.
Append exact row descriptor to canonical SSD ledger by fsync temporary JSON, atomic replace and parent-directory fsync. Only then mirror ledger in RAM and clear pending raw bytes.
At native EOF require exact native trailer and ordered complete row/hash coverage, then set LOCAL_DURABLE_COMPLETE. Local status never sets authenticated/anonymous/public_verified fields.

On failure retain staging/committed files and unparsed/unpublished tails. Post-crash orphan completed directory is retained and reported; never silently count it as committed or resume solver from partial stream.

publication_contract.transport_exhaustion_behavior: Record pending/failure and continue polling with bounded backoff; never signal or fail native producer. An immutable integrity mismatch is terminal for publication, not silent replacement; source remains retained.
publication_contract.explicit_stop: Stop and reap only own publication child tree. Native has its own explicit exact-birth stop path.
publication_contract.public_acceptance: Separate final manifest requires every exact committed part uploaded and both authenticated/anonymous full byte readbacks. Local native PASS alone is never called public delivery.

required_controls: Whole generated deck,539device config, Meter, startup_proof and acquisition thresholds exact baseline inverse; only capture queue/local-result metadata bridge changes.
Actual byte stream with multiple parts and irregular read boundaries reconstructs same header+payload+trailer/hash/rows and unchanged reducer outputs.
Offline/timeout publisher does not impede native capture completion; late publication recovers retained parts without overwrite or solver restart.
Duplicate index/name, modified source/part, short write, diskfloor/cap, fsync/rename/ledger failures, truncated rows/trailer all fail with bytes retained.
Power-loss boundary fixtures distinguish uncommitted staging, committed orphan and canonical ledger; no partial row or orphan silently accepted.
Actual owner SIGTERM during native write and separate publisher wait/backoff closes exact children and retains source evidence; native healthy run has no elapsed timeout.
Independent source peer and saved actual controls before fresh native launch; native/public/replay results separate.
scope: Architecture contract only. No new solver or publisher launched. Exact source implementation, source peer and actual lossless/lifecycle/fault tests remain gates.
